authority_rule: The original published study is the only source of truth. Every claim scored must trace to one of this study's primary_sources, with a page, table or figure reference. If a finding in this registry is not supported by the source, mark it not_testable with reason claim_not_in_any_source and say so; the registry can be wrong, the study cannot.

primary_sources.role: species traits, Mb concentration and net charge data, ancestral inference

replication_targets.finding: Maximal Mb net surface charge (ZMb) increased along lineages evolving high Mb concentration; ZMb rises from about +1 to +7 in deep divers.
replication_targets.test: Do epistaeon's detected sites for MB concentrate on surface, charge-changing positions in 1MBO?

replication_targets.finding: Increased net positive charge is proposed to prevent aggregation at high Mb concentration.
replication_targets.test: Structural, not evolutionary: are the detected sites solvent-exposed rather than buried?

structures.notes: Sperm whale (Physeter macrocephalus), the study's focal taxon. 1.6 A, 153 residues complete, no gaps, haem plus bound O2, His93-Fe 2.1 A.

known_limitations: Mirceta 2013 crystallised no ancestral myoglobins, so 1MBO can only serve as a geometric scaffold.
No measured recombinant ancestral mutation panel. The supplement gives inferred ancestral states and trait data.
Species coverage is good: sperm whale, southern elephant seal and Weddell seal are all present in the MB alignment.
expected_outcome_note: MB1 and MB2 are genuinely testable: the focal species are present and the structure is the right taxon.
